output.title: Route53 DNS fix: no issuer or solver configuration supplied
output.content: The fix applies only to deleting DNS records through AWS Route53 (ev-23e99dfde8d0). The environment summary does not show whether this cluster uses Route53. The only manifests listed are apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, and the only installed CRD listed is certificates.cert-manager.io. No Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests or solver settings were supplied, and that missing information is not proof that Route53 is unused. To decide, check whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer in the cluster uses Route53 for DNS records.
